subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should the remaining fix land by repairing the open partial-current-image PR, or should OpenClaw keep the current all-or-nothing fallback and solve Telegram native vision through a different shared contract?
rationale: Current main and the latest release intentionally fall back when only some current-turn images resolve, while the open PR changes that shared message-delivery behavior and still has a blocking review plus proof gap.

options.title: Repair and land the open PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the fix path only after it preserves source alignment through the runner boundary and includes redacted Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback and replace the PR
options.body: Close or narrow the open PR and design a different shared native-vision resolver contract for Telegram and other channel media.

recommendation.title: Repair and land the open PR
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the fix path only after it preserves source alignment through the runner boundary and includes redacted Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc most recently changed the same resolver's mixed image-order contract, which is the contract choice blocking the candidate PR.
